candidates.tagline: Dyson's $499 toothbrush streams live footage of the inside of your mouth
candidates.story: Dyson's CameraJet, unveiled at IFA 2026, is a $499 electric toothbrush with a 100,000-pixel AI camera that identifies tooth gaps and fires precision mouthwash jets at them — and also lets you watch the operation live on your phone in real time.
candidates.why_funny: The phone shows live surveillance footage of your own teeth mid-brush, turning oral hygiene into a dental stakeout — 661 Dyson engineers apparently agreed this was the missing feature.
candidates.alt: A person holding a smartphone showing a live camera feed of the inside of their own mouth while brushing with the Dyson CameraJet toothbrush, with close-up teeth visible on the phone screen

candidates.tagline: Four HD cameras now required to tell you where your dart landed
candidates.story: Winmau's Autodarts X, launched at IFA Berlin on September 10 2026, is a £450 camera rig with four HD cameras and 360° pro-grade lighting that clips around any standard dartboard to automatically detect and score every throw via AI.
candidates.why_funny: Darts — a pub game where the entire point is watching where the dart lands — now needs four surveillance cameras and an AI ref to solve the problem of looking at the board.
candidates.alt: A traditional dartboard encircled by an elaborate ring of four HD cameras and bright studio lighting, with a tablet showing a digital scoreboard app beside it
